```text
Manage configuration

Usage: clapdemo config [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  get   Print a config value; the description is long on purpose so that clap wraps it at the fixed
        width
  set   Set a config value [alias: put]
  help  Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -v, --verbose  Increase verbosity
  -h, --help     Print help
```
